description: Clean advisory call: structured note recommended after reconfirming investor classification and risk profile, full risk/cost/lock-up/conflict-of-interest disclosure, client confirms understanding, order confirmed via readback.
notes: This is the 'good' advisory call the other fixtures are contrasted against. C05: risks, costs, restrictions (lock-up), potential losses, the conflict of interest (UBS-issued note, structuring margin), and client understanding are all explicitly covered -- PASS. Order (invest $200k) is read back and explicitly confirmed -- C03 PASS. Actions: place the order and send documentation for signature.
